summary: Plan purpose: repair Acceptance and Quick Dev trust/recovery gaps against baseline 3c285bcc; historical evidence under 2026-08-17-acceptance-coordinator-efficiency stays immutable; plan-created commit 868328c8 is not the RED baseline; self-hosted profile required; no Knowledge publication, automatic Bootstrap start, Phase runtime changes, release/deployment/archive, or multi-maintainer trust signing; lifecycle ownership unchanged: Maintainer=implementation-authorized, Quick Dev=implementation-complete, Acceptance=acceptance-passed; ACR-R0: only acceptance-coordinator-request.v3 with target plan plus hash-bound prepared input is valid, derive run via start_or_resume_target_run, resume only persisted action DAG and command registry, route from persisted projection, reject request-local booleans/assertions/receipts/successors/telemetry, v2 is historical-only; ACR-R1: reserve successor identity before materialization, reuse only byte-identical lineage/bindings, retry must resume same successor or fail closed, no duplicate/overwrite, one recoverable GREEN/prior-RED handoff record; ACR-R2: maintainer authorization binds contract, authority manifest, Knowledge selection, permitted successor kinds, Skill-input contract; verified refresh may advance only unchanged selection to new bytes, any selection/scope/contract/command/test/policy/risk change requires reauthorization; freshness can degrade without blocking execution, but authority-bearing source byte drift, missing/unreadable required sources, invalid LKG/policy/projection/staging/query-gate issues remain blockers; successor receipt must be validator-produced and bind predecessor/successor hashes, selection hash, authority hash, verified LKG pointer/manifest, read-set hashes, validator command identity, full chain, with selectionUnchanged=true, authorityUnchanged=true, publicationAuthorized=false, authorizes=[] only after recomputation; ACR-R3: legacy prior-RED/red-result/red-basis+failed observation are accepted only when selector, test bytes, execution fingerprint, and expected failure IDs all match; mismatches fail closed; compatibility only, not new TDD RED; ACR-R4: after R0-R3, read 8-17 evidence as historical, regenerate current bindings, obtain new maintainer authorization, dogfood to fresh terminal result; old authorization/result/resume/report remain immutable; identical replay must create no extra action/successor; ACR-R5: completion handoff must bind stable candidate source manifest, exact terminal result, and resume-state current receipt pointer; candidate source root includes only explicit production/test/validator/contract-consumer bytes and excludes HEAD, lifecycle state, generated artifacts, terminal results, receipts, logs, timestamps; evidence-only commits do not invalidate candidate, source changes do; open ambiguity: implementation RED must target post-repair current candidate, not predecessor behavior.
